technology_name: Trikatu Syrup Production Technology from Palm Neera
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Need for palatable delivery methods for the medicinal properties of unfermented palm tree sap and Trikatu.
description: A technology know-how for making Trikatu syrup utilizing Palm Neera (unfermented palm tree sap), dry ginger, pepper, and long pepper. The formulation provides the richness and medicinal properties of Palm Neera in a palatable form.
applications: Manufacturing of traditional Ayurvedic medical syrups ,Formulation of clinical respiratory health-support therapeutics , Production of biological bioavailability-enhancing syrup bases , Processing of unfermented palm tree sap into shelf-stable liquid forms
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
